## Summary
Provides codec-specific RTP payload header mungers used by the SFU forwarding path. The package defines the common codec munger contract, a no-op munger, and VP8 header rewriting logic for picture id, TL0 picture index, key index, padding, out-of-order packets, gaps, and temporal layer filtering.

## Responsibilities
- Define the codec munger interface used by packet forwarding.
- Provide a null munger for codecs or paths that do not need payload header rewriting.
- Rewrite VP8 payload descriptors while preserving continuity across forwarding, layer switches, gaps, and padding.
- Track VP8 picture id wrap-around and out-of-order picture id offsets.
- Report codec-specific filtering and cache-miss errors.
